name: The hydra
description: A serpent with many heads, each of which grows back if cut off; the iconic creature type of green found on many planes.

timeline.summary: Following the Sundering of Alara, hydras are limited to the Shards of Naya and Jund; during the Conflux new hydras such as the Apocalypse Hydra come into conflict with other Shards.
timeline.quote: During the Conflux , new types of Hydras, like the Apocalypse Hydra , appeared that came into conflict with the other Shards, like Bant .

citation.text: "Hydra", section "Alara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien fires the Arkbow, summoning a spectral hydra that kills nobles and disrupts the gala.
timeline.quote: the seething, glimmering green outline of a hydra wrenched itself from the arrowhead and howled its hunger for the world to see.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

relations.quote: Phytohydras are carnivorous plants with hydra-like regeneration and growth abilities grown by the Selesnya Conclave .

citation.text: "Hydra", section "Phytohydra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: Savageborn Hydras are part of the clans, which revere them.
relations.quote: The Gruul revere these multiheaded predators as vestiges of the ancient times before the guilds took over the world.

citation.text: "Hydra", section "Savageborn Hydra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

pages_say.description: A spectral green hydra summoned from the Arkbow that kills nobles.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

pages_say.description: The self-running opponent of the Challenge Deck, with many heads.
